notes: Get a myki card (from 7-Eleven). The centre is a Free Tram Zone, and the SkyBus airport transfer costs 22 AUD. For the Great Ocean Road, Phillip Island and Yarra Valley, take a tour or hire a car (they drive on the left).

NOTE: From June to September it is WINTER in Melbourne (8-14°C, rain), and you can get four seasons in one day, so dress in layers. Penguins arrive early in winter (17:45). Cafes and museums are warm. The Rising festival takes place in July.
The coffee culture is among the best in the world: try a flat white or a magic. Brunch costs 25-30 AUD, tours 130-150 AUD, and tipping is not expected.
Book the Penguin Parade online; photography is not allowed. Twelve Apostles looks best in afternoon light. Queen Vic is closed Monday and Wednesday.
Laneways: Hosier, ACDC, Centre Place, Degraves. For street art, head to Fitzroy and Collingwood, and Sydney Road in Brunswick.
UV is high in summer, so wear sunscreen. Tap water is safe to drink.

transit.name: myki
transit.why_chosen: Covers trams, trains and buses. Trams in the centre are FREE (Free Tram Zone), and the daily cap is about 11 AUD.

stops.name: Hosier Lane
stops.tips: Graffiti lane that changes daily, next to ACDC Lane.

stops.name: Degraves Street Breakfast
stops.tips: Laneway cafes: try a flat white and avocado toast, then walk on to Centre Place.

stops.name: State Library Victoria La Trobe Reading Room
stops.tips: Octagonal reading room, free to enter. Ned Kelly's armour is on display.

stops.name: Federation Square & ACMI
stops.tips: ACMI, the film museum, is free. Ian Potter NGV showcases Australian art, and the Yarra riverbank is right there.

stops.name: Lune Croissanterie Fitzroy
stops.tips: Called the "world's best croissant". Take tram 11 to Fitzroy and expect a queue.

backups.name: Higher Ground Breakfast
backups.tips: Brunch in a former power station on Little Bourke Street.

backups.name: Melbourne Museum Carlton
backups.tips: Natural history and an Aboriginal gallery, next to the Royal Exhibition Building. Alternative to ACMI.

stops.name: Queen Victoria Market
stops.tips: Market dating from 1878. Try the American Doughnut Kitchen van and the cheese and deli hall. The Wednesday night market runs in summer. Closed Monday and Wednesday.

stops.name: Royal Exhibition Building & Carlton Gardens
stops.tips: UNESCO-listed 1880 exhibition hall with fountains and gardens.

stops.name: Lygon Street
stops.tips: Little Italy: visit Brunetti pastry shop and Pellegrini's, where Melbourne coffee culture took off.

stops.name: Fitzroy Brunswick Street
stops.tips: Vintage shops, street art and the Rose Street Artists' Market at weekends.

stops.name: Naked for Satan Rooftop Bar
stops.tips: Fitzroy rooftop with city views at sunset and pintxos (Basque-style snacks).

backups.name: Pellegrini's Espresso Bar
backups.tips: Espresso bar unchanged since 1954, on Bourke Street.

backups.name: Melbourne Zoo
backups.tips: Zoo in Royal Park. Alternative to Fitzroy if you have children.

stops.name: Bells Beach
stops.tips: Tour departs 06:30 (130 AUD), or drive. Legendary surf beach at Torquay.

stops.name: Kennett River Koala Walk
stops.tips: Wild koalas and parrots in the trees along Grey River Road.

stops.name: Apollo Bay
stops.tips: Fishing town for fish and chips and calamari.

stops.name: Twelve Apostles
stops.tips: Limestone stacks (8 remain). Gibson Steps lead 86 steps down to the beach. The light is best in the afternoon.

stops.name: Loch Ard Gorge
stops.tips: Shipwreck cove and caves, 3 minutes from the Apostles. Allow 3 hours for the return journey.

backups.name: Cape Otway Lightstation
backups.tips: The oldest lighthouse on mainland Australia. Alternative to Apollo Bay.

stops.name: Brighton Bathing Boxes
stops.tips: 82 colourful bathing boxes on Dendy Street Beach. Take the train to Middle Brighton; it is quiet in the morning.

stops.name: St Kilda Esplanade & Pier
stops.tips: Take tram 96 to the pier and the Luna Park laughing mouth. Little penguins appear at sunset under the pier.

stops.name: Acland Street Cake Shops
stops.tips: Monarch Cakes (1934) and European patisseries, a legacy of Jewish immigrants.

stops.name: Luna Park Melbourne
stops.tips: Amusement park from 1912. Entry is free, and the Scenic Railway wooden roller coaster costs 15 AUD.

stops.name: St Kilda Pier Penguins
stops.tips: Little penguins on the breakwater at sunset. No flash; volunteers are on hand.

backups.name: Stokehouse St Kilda
backups.tips: Stylish restaurant right on the beach.

backups.name: Jewish Museum of Australia
backups.tips: St Kilda's Jewish museum. Alternative to the garden.

stops.name: Brighton to Phillip Island and Churchill Island
stops.tips: Tour departs 12:00 (130 AUD, penguins included), or drive for 2 hours. Historic farm with sheep shearing.

stops.name: Koala Conservation Reserve
stops.tips: Koalas seen from treetop boardwalks.

stops.name: Cape Woolamai Coastal Walk
stops.tips: Pink granite headland and surf beach, with the Pinnacles.

stops.name: The Nobbies & Seal Rocks
stops.tips: Rocky cliffs, gull colonies and fur seals. Bring binoculars.

stops.name: Penguin Parade
stops.tips: Thousands of little penguins waddle from the sea to their burrows at sunset. Book tickets online, no photography allowed, bring a coat.

backups.name: Penguin Parade Cafe
backups.tips: Visitor centre serving fish and soup.

backups.name: Panny's Chocolate Factory
backups.tips: Chocolate factory. Alternative to the koalas if you have children.

stops.name: Yarra Valley Dairy
stops.tips: Cheese tasting at Yering.

stops.name: Domaine Chandon Yarra Valley
stops.tips: Sparkling wine tasting with vineyard views. Join a tour (about 150 AUD) or drive for 1 hour.

stops.name: Healesville Sanctuary
stops.tips: Native animals: kangaroos, platypuses, wombats and a bird show.

stops.name: Yering Station
stops.tips: Wine house on a historic farm, known for pinot noir and views.

backups.name: TarraWarra Estate
backups.tips: Wine and an art museum. Alternative to Yering.

backups.name: Innocent Bystander Healesville
backups.tips: Pizza and wine in the town centre.

stops.name: Royal Botanic Gardens Victoria
stops.tips: 38 hectares of gardens, with Ornamental Lake and views of the Shrine of Remembrance.

stops.name: Shrine of Remembrance
stops.tips: City views from the memorial balcony. Free.

stops.name: Southbank Promenade
stops.tips: Yarra riverbank walk. Eureka Skydeck (30 AUD) is optional.

stops.name: Southgate Breakfast and Lunch
stops.tips: Riverside views; have a farewell flat white.

stops.name: Southern Cross SkyBus
stops.tips: SkyBus to Tullamarine takes 30 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Eureka Skydeck
backups.tips: Level 88 and the Edge glass cube.
